name: New Job
overview: Scripture encourages believers to seek God's guidance and protection in times of difficulty, trusting in His provision and defense as seen in Psalms 20:1 and 34:9. Emphasis is placed on receiving and treasuring God's commandments, maintaining a heart committed to His law (Proverbs 2:1; 3:1). Believers are called to trust fully in the Lord rather than their own understanding and to honor Him with their resources, reflecting a life centered on reverence and dependence on God (Proverbs 3:5, 3:9).
